commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is sent off by the referee for a disgraceful tackle that simply has no place in football!
90+4' Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.

90+3' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
90+3' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) leaps to collect the ball.
90+2' Raul (Osasuna) leaps under pressure from an opponent to meet a cross and sends a weak header straight at Unai Simon, who calmly saves.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
89' Ath Bilbao enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

10' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
